label: has metal element present
definition: A relation between a microbial community and a CHEBI metal cation or atom that is present in or processed by the community (e.g., iron, copper, mercury, uranium). Range deliberately points at the CHEBI metal-cation parent so per-element leaves remain CHEBI IRIs rather than fresh METPO classes.

label: has rare earth element present
definition: A relation between a microbial community and a CHEBI rare-earth-element atom or cation that is present in or processed by the community (lanthanides plus Y, Sc). Range points at the CHEBI rare-earth-atom parent so per-REE leaves remain CHEBI IRIs.

label: has metal relevance
definition: A relation between a microbial community and a metal-relevance-level class indicating how central metal or rare-earth-element cycling is to the community (primary defining function vs significant participant vs incidental vs not applicable).
